summary: Defined approval, escalation and interrupt survival for AgentOS so protected actions survive restart as exact, bounded approval states without auto-approval or widened authority.
acceptance_evidence: runtime-approval-survival.md defines durable approval state including run_id, step_id, actor, tool, resource, parameter_hash, risk, policy_version, approval_id, status, reason, timestamps and audit linkage.
Approval tokens are defined as exact bindings over actor, tool, resource, parameter_hash, expires_at and policy_version.
Restart behavior preserves AwaitingApproval as pending or expired and never auto-grants a protected action.
Interrupt, timeout, denial and escalation transitions all persist state before affecting scheduling.
Protected resumption after restart must recompute routed policy request, parameter hash and policy decision before SecurityExecution prepares any effect.
